provenance.source_title: When Did Ancient Humans First Drink Alcohol

examples.psychological_goal: 第一秒给出年代锚点并把观众指派为远古当事人,同时用现代便利缺席制造亲近笑点
examples.expression_mechanism: 第二人称身份指派 + "没有X、没有Y、没有Z"三连缺席对照
examples.example_text: You are a hunter-gatherer 13,000 years ago. No supermarkets, no refrigerators, no food delivery.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"你是某身份+年代"开场,并立即用现代物的缺席定义古代日常
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该年代、身份与缺席清单

examples.psychological_goal: 把一次反本能的偶然尝试升格为文明级悬念,给出敬畏的第一次小额回报
examples.expression_mechanism: 反本能动作白描 + 最高级定性句
examples.example_text: someone decides to drink it anyway. This man is perhaps the most important man who ever lived.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在开场用一个"不计后果的决定"加一句最高级定性,把小事抬成历史拐点
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该定性措辞;最高级必须能被后文兑现

examples.psychological_goal: 显式抛出标题问句并追加更深的二级问题,锁定全片主承诺
examples.expression_mechanism: 标题问句原样落地 + "更重要的是"二级问题抬深
examples.example_text: So, when exactly did ancient people first drink alcohol? And, more importantly, why did we even start?
examples.usage_instruction: 学习开场段末先兑现标题问句,再立刻追加一个"为什么"把承诺加深一层
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该问句;二级问题必须比标题问题更深

examples.psychological_goal: 用三连排比把答案的年代推到远超预期的深度,制造深时震撼
examples.expression_mechanism: 两次"它没有出现在"否定铺垫 + 单句深时数字落地
examples.example_text: This enzyme did not appear when humans invented wine. It did not appear when agriculture emerged. It appeared about 10 million years ago.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先连续否定两个观众以为的答案锚点,再给出一个数量级更大的真实锚点
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该数字与被否定的锚点对象

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个俏皮命名为抽象假说制造记忆点
examples.expression_mechanism: "史上最佳命名"铺垫 + 反差外号落地
examples.example_text: the best name in the history of science. He calls it the "drunken monkey" hypothesis.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在给理论命名前先吊胃口(夸它的名字),再放出反差感外号
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该外号;命名须与机制内容相符

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话翻转信号的解读方向,完成机制理解的点亮
examples.expression_mechanism: "不是X,是Y"意象重定义
examples.example_text: The smell of ethanol was not a warning sign. It was a lighthouse.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把关键机制压缩成一个"不是警告而是灯塔"式的重定义句
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该意象;重定义要基于前文已建立的证据

examples.psychological_goal: 把观众的现代负罪感重写为演化遗产,完成一次小型世界观迁移
examples.expression_mechanism: 两次否定常见误读 + 深时归因断言
examples.example_text: This is not a character flaw. This is not a weakness. That's 10 million years of adaptation working exactly as intended.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先否定两个道德化解读,再把行为归因到深时机制,解除观众心理负担
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该归因措辞

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句极短换挡句宣告叙事升级,锁定注意力
examples.expression_mechanism: 独立成段的短换挡句
examples.example_text: But at a certain point, the story changes.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在两层内容之间用一句10词以内的换挡句明确"规则变了"
examples.negative_instruction: 换挡句后必须真的有范式升级,否则是空悬念

examples.psychological_goal: 把先民的行为抬升为"近乎科学",重置观众对古人的敬意
examples.expression_mechanism: "换句话说"收束 + 现代崇高概念类比
examples.example_text: In other words, it requires something that is very much like science.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在列出能力清单后用"换句话说,这几乎就是X"为清单定性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该类比对象

examples.psychological_goal: 用产物定性反转观众预期,给出考古证据的干脆答案
examples.expression_mechanism: 肯定句 + 否定两个预期选项的排除式揭示
examples.example_text: They brewed beer, not wine or some obscure fermented liquid.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习揭示答案时顺手否定两个观众脑中的候选项,让答案更利落
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该产物与被排除项

examples.psychological_goal: 用"早于文明标志事件"的时序反转制造全片最大认知冲击之一
examples.expression_mechanism: 时序反转断言 + 身份否定补刀
examples.example_text: This happened before the advent of agriculture. The Natufians were not farmers.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在给出证据后立刻指出它早于某个观众以为的前提,并用身份否定加固
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该文明标志事件与人群名

examples.psychological_goal: 用反问+单词回答的节奏落差,把学术假说讲成会心一笑
examples.expression_mechanism: 设问悬停 + 单词回答 + 重复名词落地
examples.example_text: What could have made such a compromise worth the effort? Beer. Guaranteed beer supply.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"是什么让这一切值得?X。稳定的X供应。"的问答节奏呈现争议命题
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该答案;单词回答必须源自前文争议

examples.psychological_goal: 把该物质从娱乐重新定性为神圣,完成意义升格
examples.expression_mechanism: "从一开始"时间状语 + 否定浅层解读 + 单词定性
examples.example_text: From the very beginning, alcohol was never just a means of having fun. He was sacred.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在中段用"从来不只是X,它是Y"为全片意义换挡
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该定性;升格必须由前文证据支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个制度化细节让观众意识到该物质已进入经济系统核心
examples.expression_mechanism: 主体+配给+工资功能的单句事实呈现
examples.example_text: Sumerian workers received a daily ration of beer as a major part of their wages.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"某群体每天领到X作为工资"式制度细节替代抽象概括
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该文明与制度细节

examples.psychological_goal: 用同主语排比把该物质的社会角色一次性铺满
examples.expression_mechanism: 三连以上同主语短句排比定性
examples.example_text: Beer was currency. Beer was wages. Beer was a religion. Beer was medicine.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"X是A。X是B。X是C。"排比为一个段落盖章
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该角色清单;排比项须互不重复且递增

examples.psychological_goal: 用通感式味觉描写为复刻实验收尾,制造古今连接的幽默
examples.expression_mechanism: 现代酒+古代果的混搭比喻
examples.example_text: The taste was reportedly reminiscent of champagne mixed with dates.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习给古老事物配一个"现代X混合古代Y"的感官比喻
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该比喻组合

examples.psychological_goal: 用荒诞刑罚坐实古人对该物质的认真程度,制造黑色幽默
examples.expression_mechanism: 第二人称条件句 + 不成比例的惩罚揭示
examples.example_text: if you diluted your beer with water, the punishment was to be thrown into the river.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"如果你做了X,惩罚是Y"的失衡比例呈现法典细节
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该条款与刑罚

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句现代系统词汇为古代功能定性,制造错位震撼
examples.expression_mechanism: 程度副词+现代机构词的超短定性句
examples.example_text: Beer was literally public health infrastructure.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把古代事物的功能直接命名为现代系统概念,一句完成重估
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该现代概念;定性须与证据相符

examples.psychological_goal: 否定观众最可能的现代投射,为真实意义让位
examples.expression_mechanism: 先否定一个当代化误读(逃避现实),为下一句正面定义蓄势
examples.example_text: People didn't invent alcohol as a way to forget about problems after a long day of prehistoric farming.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"他们发明X不是为了Y"先拆掉现代投射,再给正面答案
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该投射内容

examples.psychological_goal: 用比拟格言把全片浓缩成一句可带走的判断
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定偶然说 + 向光性比拟
examples.example_text: Humanity did not come across alcohol by accident. We reached out to him like a plant reaches out to the light.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习结尾格言结构:先否定一个浅解释,再用一个自然意象比拟收束
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该比拟意象
